verdict.rationale: Enterprise or cloud-platform authentication is a fair axis for an agentic coding platform, but the pack documents no SSO, SAML/OIDC, Workspace admin, or cloud-platform (e.g., Vertex/GCP project) sign-in path. Community mentions of Google accounts and AI Pro entitlements describe consumer account access, not enterprise identity.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
